notes.message: After an unwind or a group the rows page by offset, up to offset 5000; rows written between two pages may repeat or be skipped.
A reference of 'erpLine' that resolves to nothing refuses the request (onMissing refuse, strict); not_found lose data and refuse under strict.
'erpLine' is joined in the aggregate before the page is taken, for every candidate row: a later stage reads it.
'sourceLine' comes from another service; its owner binds the select, the filter and every path under the alias.

A reference of 'sourceLine' that resolves to nothing refuses the request (onMissing refuse, strict); ambiguous, not_found, invalid_key, owner_unanswered lose data and refuse under strict. A key more than one record holds is always reported (RESOLVE_AMBIGUOUS).
'sourceLine' is joined after the page is taken, for the page's rows only.
'number' is not a member of the row owning 'transport.shipment#billingLines'; the owning row of 'sourceLine' carries it only for the other targets.
'referenceNumber' is not a member of the row owning 'transport.tour#billingLines'; the owning row of 'sourceLine' carries it only for the other targets.
'shipmentNumber' is not a member of the row owning 'transport.tour#billingLines'; the owning row of 'sourceLine' carries it only for the other targets.
'item.quantity' exists only on the variants ArticleTransactionItem, BillingLineTransactionItem, GeneralLedgerAccountTransactionItem; other rows have no value.
'item.totalPriceNet' exists only on the variants ArticleTransactionItem, BillingLineTransactionItem, GeneralLedgerAccountTransactionItem; other rows have no value.
A strict request without cursor or offset reads every matching row in its one page of 5000, or refuses (PAGE_INCOMPLETE); the page may be raised up to 5000.
